description: M/of Public Administration P.C. and L.G.- Minute of the Combined Drivers' Service for Motor Vehicle Drivers in the Public Service Amendment No. 1
reasoning: The gazette content is an amendment to the Service Minute for the Combined Drivers' Service in the Public Service. It details recruitment qualifications, examination procedures, and grading/promotion rules for public sector drivers.
